market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance is a private giant (~$220B). If it IPOs in 2026, it is likely to be the year’s largest given few comparable candidates. Reports suggest ByteDance is aiming for a Hong Kong IPO of its China operations around 2025-2026, giving a non-trivial probability (≈3%) of hitting the market in 2026 and leading the IPO size. The current implied 0.1% seems far too low.
evidence_points: ByteDance is consistently valued above $200B, putting any IPO in the top tier globally.
Recent news (2024) report ByteDance plans to IPO its domestic businesses in Hong Kong as early as 2025 or 2026.
Other mega-IPO candidates like SpaceX have seen CEO statements against going public, reducing competition for the largest 2026 IPO slot.
The TikTok divestiture deadline may accelerate a partial IPO of ByteDance’s remaining assets.
sources_consulted: Reuters: ByteDance explores IPO of Chinese operations
SEC/financial news on TikTok ban law timeline
